_about: Short showcase conversations for the dialogue system: portraits that change expression mid-line ({face:...} tags), and a crowd NPC in the plain box. They are used by the dialogue bench (scenes/debug/dialogue_test.tscn), the screenshots and the tests; the Writer's real town lines live in their own files. Placeholder text.

demo_mox_faces.speaker: mox
demo_mox_faces.text: Behold! My Automatic Door-Opener-Closer-Opener! {face:panicking}Wait. Why is it ticking? {face:sheepish}Tuesday, did you touch the button? {face:proud}Never mind! Ticking means it's working.

demo_otis_faces.speaker: otis
demo_otis_faces.text: Welcome to Harrow Landing, friend. {face:apologetic}Sorry about the smell. {face:laughing}That's the harbor! We stopped noticing years ago. {face:calm}You'll get used to it.

demo_crowd_dockhand.speaker: crowd_dockhand
demo_crowd_dockhand.text: Mind the cranes. They only swing at folks who ask if they're safe.

demo_crowd_dockhand.speaker: crowd_dockhand
demo_crowd_dockhand.text: Lamps are lit, tide's in, and nobody's lost a boat since Tuesday. Good night, all around.

demo_crowd_named_line.speaker: crowd_townsfolk
demo_crowd_named_line.name: Baker
demo_crowd_named_line.text: Fresh rolls! Still warm, still slightly crooked, still the best on the dock.
